'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Taliban–ISIL conflict]]
***Two [[Taliban]] policemen and three [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] gunmen are killed during a gunbattle at a hideout in [[Kabul]]. Four other officers are wounded. [https://gandhara.rferl.org/a/afghanistan-gunbattle-taliban-islamic-state-khorasan/31973149.html (Gandhara)]
*[[2021–2022 Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis]]
**Reignited clashes in the disputed [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] region between [[Armenia]] and [[Azerbaijan]] kill three soldiers and injure fourteen others. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/troops-azerbaijan-nagorno-karabakh-clash-killed-87880001 (ABC News)]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seventeen people are killed and four others are injured after a minibus collides with a truck in Juhaynah, [[Sohag Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.gulfnews.com/amp/world/mena/17-killed-3--injured-in-vehicle-collision-in-southern-egypt-1.89688922 (''Gulf News'')]
*Two people are killed after heavy flooding in [[The Gambia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/floods-affect-thousands-gambia-after-heaviest-rainfall-decades-2022-08-03/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are injured after an explosion at a factory in [[Bergerac, Dordogne|Bergerac]], [[France]]. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/international/factory-explosion-in-bergerac-in-southwest-france-leaves-8-injured-122080400108_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
'''International relations'''
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**[[2022 United States congressional delegation visit to Taiwan]]
***[[China]] warns airlines to avoid areas near [[Taiwan]] as it conducts military exercises in response to [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]]'s visit to the island. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-08-03/china-warns-airlines-to-avoid-areas-near-taiwan-as-tensions-rise (Bloomberg)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three people are killed and six others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack at a kindergarten in [[Anfu County]], [[Jiangxi]], China. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/killed-injured-attack-chinese-kindergarten-87865382 (ABC News)]
*[[Belarus|Belarusian]] journalist Iryna Slaunikava is sentenced to five years in prison amidst a government crackdown on the media following [[2020–2021 Belarusian protests|protests]] that occurred after the [[2020 Belarusian presidential election]]. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/belarusian-journalist-slaunikava-prison-term-crackdown/31972401.html (RFE/RL)]
*American basketball player [[Brittney Griner]] is sentenced to nine years in prison by a Russian court after being found guilty of bringing cannabis-infused vape cartridges into Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/basketball-star-brittney-griner-awaits-fate-russia-drugs-trial-2022-08-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Prime Minister of Peru]] [[Aníbal Torres]] resigns citing "personal reasons", amid multiple criminal investigations focusing on [[President of Peru|president]] [[Pedro Castillo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/perus-pm-torres-resigns-personal-reasons-2022-08-03/ (Reuters)]
*The former chairman of the [[Values Union|Union of Values]] and federal presidential candidate for the [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]], [[Max Otte]], is legally expelled from the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|CDU]]. [https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/max-otte-nach-engagement-fuer-die-afd-aus-der-cdu-ausgeschlossen-a-f941543f-2ec9-44f3-96ac-8ad66ca58b34 (''Der Spiegel'')]
